Privacy

Witchbench has no analytics, advertising, account system, or tracking cookies. Searches and chart selections stay in your browser’s memory and reset when you reload. A local-storage entry named witchbench_notice remembers that you dismissed the privacy notice for up to 182 days. Use the Cookies control to review it, or clear this site’s browser data to remove it.

Your browser requests the site and archived files from the hosting provider, which may process ordinary request information such as IP addresses and browser headers. External source and GitHub links open services with their own privacy policies. Feedback posted to a public GitHub issue is public. Privacy questions can be raised in the project repository. Updated September 29, 2026.
